primary_endpoint: Equal-weight mean of six cell-level LER differences, B_regime_calibrated minus A_basis_global_calibrated.
primary_unit: Independent seed root (20 roots in each memory-basis by generating-regime cell).

primary_signflip.statistic: mean over six cells of each cell's mean paired root error-rate difference
primary_signflip.p_value: (1 + number of absolute randomized statistics at least as large as observed) / (assignments + 1)

primary_bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap; sample 20 roots with replacement independently within each of six cells, compute six cell means, then equal-weight average

alternative_bank_candidates_vs_global.definition: For each of six cells, compare each of the two decoder assumptions other than that basis's selected global index against the selected global index.

descriptive_paired_analysis.exact_mcnemar: Two-sided exact binomial test on shot-level candidate-only and baseline-only failures; descriptive because root is the inferential unit.
descriptive_paired_analysis.disagreements: Per-pair prediction disagreement counts/rates on identical detector samples.
descriptive_paired_analysis.ler_intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for shot-level rates, descriptive only.
descriptive_paired_analysis.oracles: Per-regime and per-shot evaluation-label oracles reported as unattainable descriptive lower bounds only.

selection.global_fixed: Within each basis, select the candidate minimizing the equal-weight mean of three regime calibration LERs; exact ties to lowest index.
selection.regime_informed: Within each basis and generating regime, select the candidate minimizing calibration LER; exact ties to lowest index.
